# participation instrument

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:participationInstrument`](gmeow-participationInstrument.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/participationInstrument>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/music`](../../slices/music.md)

The kind of instrument involved in this performance participation. One instrument type per [`PerformanceParticipation`](../classes/gmeow-PerformanceParticipation.md) is recommended; mint one participation per instrument (SHACL advisory).
